create_pixel_dist_matrix: create a squared Euclidean distance matrix for all pixel coordinates on a given grid size
sample_fg_pixels_randperm: sample foreground pixel indices from a binary mask using random permutation
sample_fg_pixels_multinomial: sample foreground pixel indices from a binary mask using multinomial distribution without replacement
build_PixToShapeCycleLoss: build a PyTorch module that computes cycle loss for pixel-vertex correspondence in DensePose CSE embeddings
run_PixToShapeCycleLoss_forward: run the forward pass of PixToShapeCycleLoss to compute cycle loss given proposals, predictor outputs, annotations, and an embedder
